name: M by M0
oneLiner: M is M0's institutional dollar stablecoin, minted by permissioned Minters against eligible collateral with on-chain Validator attestations.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: M0's Ethereum MToken mint and burn paths route through MinterGateway, and the Solana Token-2022 M deployment is documented as frozen-by-default with thawing limited to approved earners. That Solana holder-account control is direct FreezeWatch exposure for M.

mintAuthority.summary: M minting is routed through the Ethereum M0 MinterGateway, with cross-chain representations bridged through M0 portal infrastructure.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway
controls.capDescription: MToken.mint is callable only by the MinterGateway; MinterGateway issuance depends on TTG-approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294742: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. eth_getCode confirms deployed contract. Slot 1 contains ERC712 domain name 'MinterGateway'. No external admin surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders via Registrar) — canRaiseCap=true, no modules applicable.

controls.label: M Solana SPL mint authority
controls.capDescription: Solana M is a spoke deployment bridged from Ethereum M through the M0 portal/transceiver design; base supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway. The SPL Token-2022 mintAuthority is a 1-of-2 SPL multisig (ms2SCrTYioPuumF6oBvReXoVRizEW5qYkiVuUEak7Th) whose two signers are off-curve PDAs controlled by M0 Portal and allied programs; all programs share upgrade authority 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Solana M is a spoke deployment bridged from Ethereum M; base supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The SPL mint authority is a 1-of-2 SPL multisig whose signers are off-curve PDAs controlled by M0 portal/allied programs.
routeChecks.caps: Effective Solana mint capacity is bounded by the portal route and base M supply, not by an immutable Solana token cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: M0 Solana programs share upgrade authority 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW; extension authorities point to the same EOA where checked.

controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432835922, the M mint reported mintAuthority=ms2SCrTYioPuumF6oBvReXoVRizEW5qYkiVuUEak7Th, a 1-of-2 SPL multisig with the same two program-derived signers recorded previously. The mint freeze authority remained null, and the M0 Portal program resolved to programData GBcoKgAk... with upgrade authority 9QpF8a9T....

sources.label: M0 Research — approved collateral structures for Minters (2024-11-20)

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530270, verified MinterGateway and MToken contracts had zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots; MToken.minterGateway() resolved to the reviewed gateway. Gateway reads returned TTG Registrar 0x119F..., mint ratio 9950, mint delay 300 seconds, and validator threshold 1. At finalized Solana slot 432835922, the Portal program was upgradeable through the explicitly reviewed 9QpF8a9T... authority. Contract and validator-attested issuance is continuously constrained onchain; no mint-authority incident is recorded in the reviewed sources. On 2026-07-15, the current M0 minting specification was rechecked: collateral values require approved validator signatures, expire on a governance-set interval that is typically daily, and bound mint execution to the verified collateral ratio after a delay. Because that third-party validator constraint is independent of a minter's signing path, the economic cap remains raiseable rather than unbounded; there is no unified prudential supervisor. On 2026-07-17 the supervision and reconciliation facts were re-verified against first-party sources: M0's roles and MinterGateway documentation describe independent permissioned Validators signing minter collateral updates under the Adopted Guidance's independence and licensing criteria, and no prudential supervisor (NYDFS/OCC/SEC/MiCA-class) was located for the M issuance regime, so supervision remains attestation-only. The Protocol API configuration history (queried 2026-07-17) shows update_collateral_interval 108000 seconds (30 hours, unchanged since 2024-05-15), update_collateral_threshold 1, mint_delay 300, and mint_ratio 9950; expired collateral counts as zero and minting is bounded by the verified collateral ratio, so supply-vs-reserve verification remains a periodic (30-hour) attestation cycle rather than per-transaction reconciliation. The M0 Foundation research post of 2024-11-20 documents the approved collateral custody structures (CrossLend GmbH / Asset Repository S.a.r.l / DEKA Bank, and Superstate Inc. / Superstate Asset Trust / UMB Bank, N.A.). No open enforcement action, lawsuit, or consent order naming M0 Foundation or the M token was located in 2026-07-17 searches, consistent with the 2026-06-18 GENIUS negative-evidence review.

collateral: Eligible cash, Treasury, and token collateral reported by M0's protocol API; static category, token, and minter weights remain unresolved and are supplied dynamically by the configured live-reserve adapter
pegMechanism: Permissioned Minters pledge eligible collateral; Validators attest collateral sufficiency before on-chain minting, while POWER token holders govern eligible collateral and Minter/Validator permissions

applicabilityBasis.summary: M is M0's core dollar token minted and burned by permissioned minters against eligible off-chain collateral verified by validators.

genius.issuerEntity: M0 Foundation (Swiss protocol/governance entity); actual minting by separately permissioned Minter entities (e.g. MXON, Anchorage Digital, Bridge/Stripe)
genius.notes: M0 Foundation is a Swiss-domiciled protocol layer and governance entity — not itself a US-formed PPSI candidate. Actual M token minting is performed by separately permissioned Minter entities (MXON, Anchorage Digital, Bridge/Stripe, MoonPay, etc.), which may individually seek GENIUS Act status. No PPSI application, state-qualified approval, or foreign-issuer exception has been publicly announced for M0 Foundation or the base M token. Rulemaking remains at NPRM stage as of 2026-06-18.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception source was located for M0 Foundation or the M token. M0 Foundation is Swiss-domiciled and acts as a protocol/governance layer, not as a US-formed PPSI. Permissioned Minters (Anchorage, Bridge, etc.) are the actual token issuers and may seek individual GENIUS Act authorization, but no such public filing was found as of 2026-06-18.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: M0 documents M Portals as the multichain architecture for M, with Ethereum as the authoritative issuance and governance source and Wormhole NTT implementing hub lock/release plus spoke mint/burn logic. That is reviewed as external lock/mint bridge exposure. 2026-07-20 cohort dc-1 pass: resolved the flagged non-native route controls with on-chain reads, including Solana's documented M Portal program; see per-row reviewNote evidence.
